Name: Ali's Foraging Map
Author: strawberrymilk95
Description:
[b]12/08/19 UPDATE:[/b]
Unfortunately I will no longer be supporting this mod meaning there will be no future updates. However, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42430915]DaniCrypt[/url] has created some alternate versions with bug fixes, which you can find [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2381]here[/url]

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

This map overrides the FORAGING/FOREST Map.

Features:
- A swimming hole where you can replenish your energy!
- More tree stumps!
- A secret area above Grandpa's shine!
- A fresh new look ready for you to make your own!
[u][b]
IMPORTANT NOTES:[/b][/u]
- entering the swimming pond area will change you into your swimwear so you can go swimming, since you're unable to use any tools or anything in your swimwear preventing you from developing the area i've created a secret side entrance that doesnt change you into your togs so you can explore the area as normal (see images for info on how to find the secret entrance)
- the secret entrance to the pond is blocked off by two rocks, you need a pickaxe to break them (duh) they're not big rocks so an un-upgraded pickaxe is fine
- dont try to go swimming in your clothes. I mean, you can if you want nothing is stopping you but it causes some weird animations and stuff so there's your warning
- if you are installing this map to play on an already made save the shrubs/bushes wont change and will still be in their old locations. if you want to remove the old shrubs I think you can hit them with your axe or use a save editor to remove them ([url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/127/?]like this one[/url])

[u][b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/b][/u]
- backup your orginal farm_foraging.xnb file first by renaming it 'farm_foraging_BACKUP.xnb' or something
- unzip the downloaded file (you'll need winzip or something like that) and place it in Content\Maps
- thats it! have fun playing :>

[u][b]CREDITS:
[/b][/u]I'm using Eemie's map recolor in these screenshots which you can find [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/599/?]here[/url]
